title: SP u džudu za veterane: Prva medalja za BiH, Evropljanima svih 18 zlata
content:
SP u džudu za veterane: Prva medalja za BiH, Evropljanima svih 18 zlata
Današnji dan donio je i veliko slavlje za domaću publiku jer je Bosna i Hercegovina stigla do prve medalje na ovom takmičenju. Bosnu i Hercegovinu danas je predstavljalo devet takmičara: Hasan Mehić, Avdo Bešić, Zijad Sejdinović, Milanko Mučibabić, Nikola Kljajić, Arif Libić, Elvir Salihagić, Zikret Hasanica i Dragan Božović.
Junak dana za našu reprezentaciju bio je Mučibabić, koji je u kategoriji veterana M9 do 100 kilograma osvojio srebrnu medalju. Na putu do finala Mučibabić je bio bolji od rivala iz Francuske, Velike Britanije i Rusije, dok mu je najsjajnije odličje izmaklo porazom od reprezentativca Kube Luisa Torresa Cobasa.
Finalne borbe ponudile su vrhunski džudo, a dominantnu ulogu imali su evropski takmičari kojima su pripale sve zlatne medalje današnjeg programa.
Najuspješnija je bila Njemačka sa tri osvojena zlata, dok su po dvije zlatne medalje izborili predstavnici Austrije, Rusije, Rumunije i Francuske. Po jedno najsjajnije odličje otišlo je u Moldaviju, Brazil, Hrvatsku, Španiju, Češku, Švedsku i Nizozemsku.
Nakon četvrtog takmičarskog dana došlo je i do promjena na vrhu tabelarnog poretka. Gruzija je zadržala vodeću poziciju sa devet zlatnih medalja, na drugo mjesto se probila Francuska sa sedam, dok je treća Rusija sa šest. Po pet zlatnih odličja u dosadašnjem toku takmičenja sakupili su Brazil i Kazahstan.
Podsjećamo, ovo jedno od najmasovnijih takmičenja u organizaciji Džudo saveza Bosne i Hercegovine okuplja 1.350 takmičara iz 65 zemalja.
Nakon završetka veteranskih borbi, vikend u Areni Hills rezervisan je za takmičenje u katama i Specijalnu olimpijadu, a ulaz za sve ljubitelje džuda i dalje je besplatan.

title: Salaspils unveils new concert hall
content:
From a Soviet-era cultural centre to a new cultural venue – the Salaspils Concert Hall now stands in the centre of Salaspils on the site of the former ‘Enerģētiķis’ cultural centre. The project was funded entirely from local authority funds. The total cost was 18.5 million euros.
Among the first musicians to perform on the new, spacious stage, accompanied by the Vidzeme Chamber Orchestra under the conductor Andris Veismanis, were singers Marija Naumova and Linda Leen, as well as the band “Musiqq”.
“I rate this concert hall very highly; a big thank you to the builders and to everyone who has worked to make this a reality here in Salaspils! It is a real pleasure and honour for me to perform here as a conductor and as the director of the Vidzeme Chamber Orchestra. (..) The atmosphere is excellent; everything is very well laid out, with thought given to the performers and the facilities for changing; there’s plenty of space. I think that, for the Salaspils district as a whole, this is one of the best concert halls in the Pieriga region that I know of. Especially for this kind of music – pop music combined with a classical orchestra sounds really good,” said Andris Veismanis, artistic director and conductor of the Vidzeme Chamber Orchestra, with delight.
“I can say that the sound is truly excellent and the stage is cosy – large and deep, which is very important. Do you know what I’m thinking of? I sang in this concert hall, in this cultural centre, some thirty years ago. It’s a huge pleasure that we have a venue like this, a cultural space like this, so close to Riga,” shared singer Marija Naumova, giving her first impressions.
Linda Leen agreed with her colleague: “It’s great that there’s another venue near Riga with new technology and a good atmosphere. I hope the venue does well and has many colourful days ahead.”

title: Épouser une Russe en 2026 : la paperasse, pas le fantasme
content:
Épouser une Russe en 2026 : la paperasse, pas le fantasme
Visas, justificatifs, traductions, voyages via Istanbul : former un couple entre la Belgique et la Russie est devenu un parcours administratif. Loin des clichés, celles et ceux qui s'y engagent font un choix plus réfléchi que bien des couples formés au coin d'une rue.
- Publié le 20-09-2026 à 16h01
Une carte blanche de Valentin Le Normand, entrepreneur français installé à Moscou depuis 2022, fondateur de l'agence matrimoniale internationale Valentin Love
Depuis quatre ans, je dirige à Moscou une agence matrimoniale qui présente des femmes russes et biélorusses à des hommes d'Europe de l'Ouest. Quand je dis mon métier à Bruxelles ou à Paris, on me parle de passeports, de femmes soumises ou d'hommes naïfs. Personne ne me parle jamais de ce qui occupe réellement mes journées : les formulaires.
Américains et Britanniques sont exclus du dispositif
Un couple belgo-russe ou franco-russe, en 2026, est d'abord une épreuve de patience administrative, et elle commence avant la première rencontre. Pour aller la voir, un Belge, comme un Français, obtient un visa électronique en quelques jours, cinquante-deux dollars, trente jours sur place. Ses amis américains ou britanniques n'ont pas cette chance : leurs passeports sont exclus du dispositif et passent par le consulat, avec bon de réservation, assurance et rendez-vous physique. Ensuite il faut y aller. Il n'y a plus de vol direct entre l'Union européenne et la Russie. On passe par Istanbul, on compte une journée de voyage, et l'on arrive avec des cartes bancaires qui ne fonctionnent pas sur place, donc avec du liquide.
Elle doit fournir des preuves qu'elle a une raison de rentrer : un emploi, un bail, un enfant scolarisé
Dans l'autre sens, c'est plus dur. Pour qu'elle vienne en Belgique, il faut un visa Schengen de court séjour déposé chez un prestataire à Moscou ou à Saint-Pétersbourg, avec un engagement de prise en charge validé par la commune, un justificatif de domicile et les revenus de celui qui l'accueille, une assurance couvrant trente mille euros de frais médicaux, et surtout des preuves qu'elle a une raison de rentrer : un emploi, un bail, un enfant scolarisé. Le motif de refus le plus courant n'est pas la fraude, c'est un dossier qui ne démontre pas assez l'intention de retour. Un profil solide, emploi stable, appartement, enfant, peut être refusé pour dix jours de vacances parce qu'une pièce manque.
En Belgique, si le mariage se célèbre à la commune, l'officier de l'état civil peut demander l'avis du parquet avant de le célébrer.
Le mariage lui-même se prépare des deux côtés. En Belgique, si le mariage se célèbre à la commune, l'officier de l'état civil peut demander l'avis du parquet avant de le célébrer ; s'il se célèbre en Russie, le futur époux demande d'abord à son ambassade un certificat de non-empêchement à mariage. En Russie, l'état civil exige des documents apostillés et traduits par un traducteur assermenté. Si la cérémonie a lieu là-bas, l'épouse dépose ensuite une demande de visa de regroupement familial, le dossier passe par l'ambassade puis par l'Office des étrangers, et l'on compte en mois, pas en semaines. Pendant ce temps, le couple vit à distance, et les applications d'appel que l'on utilise en Europe ne fonctionnent plus toutes là-bas.
La femme qui vient nous voir a en moyenne quarante-deux ans. Plus de neuf sur dix ont un diplôme du supérieur, deux sur trois parlent anglais, une sur onze parle français
Alors pourquoi le font-ils ? Parce que le fantasme, dans cette histoire, est du côté de ceux qui n'ont jamais regardé les chiffres. La femme qui vient nous voir a en moyenne quarante-deux ans. Plus de neuf sur dix ont un diplôme du supérieur, deux sur trois parlent anglais, une sur onze parle français. Près de neuf sur dix ont déjà un enfant, exactement comme les Russes de leur génération : le recensement de 2021 compte 86 % de mères parmi les femmes de trente-cinq à trente-neuf ans. Elle s'est mariée vers vingt-cinq ans, elle a eu son premier enfant à vingt-six, elle a divorcé entre trente et trente-quatre. Elle n'a pas besoin d'un passeport, elle a un métier. Elle cherche un homme qui reste.
Un homme en moyenne entre 40 et 55 ans
L'homme, de son côté, n'est pas celui qu'on imagine non plus. Il a entre quarante et cinquante-cinq ans, souvent un divorce derrière lui, une maison, une carrière, et une lassitude des applications où l'on compare des visages sans jamais rencontrer personne. Les femmes de notre base disent chercher un homme de trente-huit à cinquante-deux ans. Ces deux populations se ressemblent bien plus qu'on ne le croit. Elles sont séparées par plus de deux mille kilomètres et une pile de formulaires.
Je ne plaide pas pour que l'administration ferme les yeux. Les contrôles existent parce que des abus existent, et des professionnels sérieux ont intérêt à ce qu'ils existent. Je plaide pour que l'on cesse de parler de ces couples comme d'une anomalie. Un mariage belgo-russe en 2026 demande des mois de patience, plusieurs allers-retours par Istanbul, une langue commune apprise tard et une confiance construite à distance. Ceux qui vont au bout ont fait un choix plus réfléchi que bien des couples formés au coin d'une rue. On peut au moins leur accorder cela : ils savent ce qu'ils font.

title: Motoristas e motociclista resgatam idosa de 89 anos perdida na Linha Vermelha, no Rio; vídeo
content:
Motoristas e motociclista resgatam idosa de 89 anos perdida na Linha Vermelha, no Rio; vídeo
Uma cena preocupante terminou em uma bonita mobilização no Rio de Janeiro. Dona Deci, uma idosa de 89 anos, ficou perdida pelo acostamento da Linha Vermelha, uma via perigosa do Rio que também tem trânsito intenso, depois de sair sozinha do Hospital do Fundão.
A idosa havia ido ao hospital buscar medicamentos e pretendia voltar para casa, em Bonsucesso, na Zona Norte. Em algum ponto do caminho, porém, entrou por engano na via expressa. Foi quando três desconhecidos perceberam que ela estava em perigo.
Dois motoristas de aplicativo e um motociclista interromperam o que estavam fazendo para acompanhar Dona Deci e encontrar uma maneira segura de tirá-la dali.
Motorista ligou o pisca-alerta
Diego Marciano Vieira foi um dos primeiros a notar a idosa andando pela Linha Vermelha.
Preocupado com a proximidade dos carros, ele reduziu a velocidade, ligou o pisca-alerta e passou a acompanhar Dona Deci com o veículo, protegendo-a do trânsito enquanto tentava convencê-la a aceitar ajuda. A idosa, no entanto, continuava caminhando.
Logo depois, o motociclista Christian Quirgo também parou. Ele conversou com Dona Deci e se ofereceu para levá-la para casa, mas havia um problema: Christian não tinha um segundo capacete. Foi nesse momento que apareceu outro motorista.
Leia mais notícia boa sobre heróis sem capa

A carona para Dona Deci
Ricardo Gonçalves, também motorista de aplicativo, viu a movimentação e decidiu ajudar. Como estava de carro, conseguiu convencer Dona Deci a entrar e seguiu com ela.
Durante o trajeto, Ricardo percebeu que a idosa conseguia conversar normalmente e sabia onde pretendia chegar. A impressão dele foi de que Dona Deci havia apenas se confundido ao sair do hospital e seguido pela direção errada.
Ela mesma contou que estava acostumada a fazer o caminho entre o hospital e a casa e que nunca havia se perdido dessa forma. Ricardo levou a idosa até a Avenida Brasil, na entrada do Parque União, no Complexo da Maré.
Família foi buscá-la
Depois que o vídeo da mobilização começou a circular nas redes sociais, moradores da região ajudaram a localizar os parentes de Dona Deci.
Wanderson Kaiky, que mora na região, informou que conseguiu conversar com a família. Os parentes foram até o local, buscaram a idosa e ficaram com ela.
Felizmente, ela passa bem, graças aos motoristas e ao motociclista, que foram verdadeiros anjos da guarda na vida dessa senhora.

title: LAND: a Cinema In Verde l’anteprima dei cortometraggi dei giovani filmmaker palestinesi
content:
Dodici giovani filmmaker palestinesi, due mesi di formazione e sei cortometraggi per raccontare attraverso il cinema luoghi e storie a partire dal proprio punto di vista e dalla propria esperienza di vita nei territori occupati. Sei testimonianze dirette che mostrano, per esempio, come la parola “casa” possa passare anche dalla conservazione delle proprie tradizioni culinarie o come il rumore del cannone del Gianicolo, che a mezzogiorno scandisce il tempo della Capitale, possa richiamare da vicino i suoni di un conflitto vissuto quotidianamente. Sono il risultato di LAND, la scuola di cinema rivolta a giovani della Cisgiordania e di Gaza, promossa da Cinema In Verde e ACS – Associazione Cooperazione e Solidarietà.
I cortometraggi nati durante il percorso saranno presentati in anteprima domenica 20 settembre alle 19 all’Arena di Piazza Vittorio, nella giornata conclusiva della quarta edizione di Cinema In Verde, il festival internazionale di cinema ambientale e sociale che dal 17 al 20 settembre porta a Roma film, documentari e incontri dedicati al rapporto tra ambiente, territori e comunità.
LAND ha coinvolto dodici giovani in una spring school di due mesi che ha unito formazione e produzione, accompagnandoli dalla costruzione delle storie fino alla realizzazione dei cortometraggi. Il lavoro è stato sviluppato insieme a tre realtà della formazione e del cinema: IED Roma, sede romana dell’Istituto Europeo di Design, Groenlandia Film, società di produzione fondata da Matteo Rovere e Sydney Sibilia e Pandataria Film, società di produzione audiovisiva specializzata nel documentario.
Con IED Roma hanno preso forma Homemade e The Missing Memory; con Groenlandia Film sono stati realizzati The Mirror, Point of Encounter e 12 O’Clock; con Pandataria Film è nato HeartLand. I sei corti portano sullo schermo sguardi diversi e restituiscono ai partecipanti la possibilità di scegliere in prima persona che cosa raccontare, quali immagini usare e da quale punto di vista partire. La proiezione chiude così un percorso iniziato con la formazione e arrivato fino al confronto con il pubblico: dalla scrittura delle storie alla realizzazione dei film, fino alla loro prima presentazione a Roma.
“Siamo felici non solo di poter mostrare i lavori realizzati, ma soprattutto di aver raggiunto l’obiettivo con cui LAND è nato: offrire una formazione concreta e creare possibilità reali di entrare nel mondo del cinema e dell’audiovisivo”, dichiara Simonetta Lombardo, ideatrice di Cinema In Verde e del progetto LAND.
“LAND non vuole limitarsi a raccontare una terra, ma dare strumenti e occasioni a chi quella terra la vive e vuole poterla raccontare con la propria voce. Le competenze acquisite e le relazioni costruite stanno già mettendo nelle mani dei ragazzi e delle ragazze opportunità concrete, sia in Palestina, attraverso realtà culturali e progetti locali, sia con l’industria cinematografica e audiovisiva e con gli istituti di formazione creativa italiani. Per noi il progetto non finisce qui: continueremo a creare occasioni per questi giovani e per altri che verranno dopo di loro, perché crediamo che garantire accesso alla formazione, alla cultura e al lavoro significhi anche difendere la possibilità di scegliere il proprio futuro”.
A presentare i lavori saranno Duaa Abu Snaineh e Hazem Madi, due dei dodici giovani filmmaker che hanno partecipato a LAND. Con loro, sul palco dell’Arena di Piazza Vittorio, Matteo Rovere, regista e produttore di Groenlandia e presidente della giuria di Cinema In Verde 2026, Laura Negrini, direttrice di IED Roma, Viola Damiani di Pandataria Film e l’attrice Giulia Michelini. A moderare l’incontro sarà Erika Favaro di Hollywood Party, Rai Radio3. A seguire si terranno la premiazione del Ginkgo d’Oro 2026 e la proiezione del film vincitore del concorso internazionale.
A rendere possibile il progetto LAND, 10 famiglie ospitanti e un crowdfunding con Etica SGR e Produzioni dal basso, oltre al contributo di Intercultura, Sapienza Università di Roma e Zen2030 e alla sponsorship di NaturaSì.

title: Jay Meena: From mischievous boy to first Indian Asian Games medallist in soft tennis
content:
Pritish Raj works with sports team at The Indian Express' and is based out of New Delhi. ... Read More
- Tags:
- Asian Games
- Asian Games 2026
As Jay Meena walked towards the podium to collect his bronze medal in Soft Tennis at the Asian Games — a first-ever for India in the sport — all he did was breathe a sigh of relief.
“More than anything, I was relieved. We had lost two medal chances in mixed doubles and men’s doubles before that. So, just the thought that I’ll return empty handed gave me chills the night before,” Jay tells The Indian Express from Japan. He lost to Japan’s Takuya Kurosaka 2-3 in the semifinal but had assured the medal.
Click here to read our Asian Games full coverage
It is poetic that the child, who was admitted to Soft Tennis so that he stayed away from mischief, became the first to win a medal for his country in the country where the sport was born.
Soft Tennis barely had any footprint in India; nor was there a sporting hero. His father put him on a softball court to curb his naughty side.
“I was a restless kid, honestly. I was rusticated for one such mischief when I was in fourth standard and wasn’t getting admission anywhere,” says Jay. “Then I got admission at the Pioneer Public school and there were two soft tennis courts. The courts always fascinated me,” he adds.
Once his father realised his energy can be channelled into the sport, he started pushing him. “During summer breaks, my father constantly asked me to hit the court and play soft tennis. Once I started, time flew fast. I started winning medals quickly at the national level. In no time, I am here standing on the Asian Games podium,” Jay gushes.
Interestingly, Jay’s journey as a sportsperson inspired his youngest cousin, Dev Meena, who is the national record holder in Pole Vault. “I took up sport after looking at Jay bhaiya. He is the inspiration behind my sporting journey. Right now, I am more tense about his medal as he was very close last time,” Dev had told this masthead before leaving for Japan.
Jay says his brother’s achievements fill him with pride, “What do I say about him? Whenever I see him breaking the national record, it makes me feel proud. Sadly, I won’t be there to cheer for him later during his competition as I’m leaving tomorrow, but I am confident he will come back with a medal.”
Reaching the podium was not the difficult part for Jay, who hails from Dewas in Madhya Pradesh. But convincing people that soft tennis, one of Lawn Tennis’s oldest spin-offs, was as serious a sport as other variations, certainly was.
To the uninitiated, he explains the difference between the two. “There are a few basic differences but overall the core of the game is the same,” says Jay. “Balls in soft tennis are very light and so are the racquets, which make all the difference.”
It is played in straight points format like badminton rather than the usual point system of tennis. Singles is played in a best of seven format with four points being the winning point while the doubles games are best-of-nine affairs.
“The light ball plays an important role. It’s unlike tennis where the power on the ball allows it to travel. In soft tennis, the athletes have to use their own power rather than relying on the opponent’s shots to angle a return. Since the ball is light, it is affected by wind in the arena also. All of this makes it physically intense,” explains Jay.
Jay hopes that the medal will bring the much needed spotlight on the otherwise neglected sport.
“There is infrastructure, there is talent and there are players, all we need is investment. I had no support apart from the Sports Ministry’s Target Asian Games scheme. I am still without a job, if my medal can bring more limelight to the sport, I think that will be my real victory,” he signs off .

title: Ko dom postane prostor oskrbe: kaj je dobro vedeti, ko skrbite za bližnjega?
content:
V želji, da bi njihov bližnji čim dlje ostal doma in hkrati prejemal kakovostno oskrbo, se zgodbe številnih družinskih oskrbovalcev začnejo podobno. Sprva gre za pomoč pri nakupih, spremstvo k zdravniku ali pripravo obrokov. Sčasoma pa se lahko pojavijo še težave z gibljivostjo, osebno higieno, demenca in inkontinenca. Takrat dom nenadoma postane prostor polne oskrbe.
S tem pa pridejo tudi vprašanja: Kako organizirati nego, ko sem v službi, po opravkih? Kako preprečiti zaplete? Kje poiskati pomoč? In kako ob vseh obveznostih poskrbeti tudi zase?
Domača oskrba je danes resničnost številnih slovenskih družin. Po podatkih Inštituta Antona Trstenjaka za gerontologijo in medgeneracijsko sožitje doma nekoga oskrbuje več kot 300.000 ljudi, družinski oskrbovalci pa zagotovijo približno 80 odstotkov vse oskrbe.
Skrb za bližnjega ni le fizično zahtevna, ampak lahko pomeni tudi čustveno in organizacijsko obremenitev. Zato je pomembno, da se o oskrbi bližnjega družina temeljito pogovori in pridobi čim več informacij. Viri informacij in podpore so lahko:
V okviru sistema dolgotrajne oskrbe lahko upravičenci koristijo različne oblike podpore, med drugim oskrbovalca družinskega člana, dolgotrajno oskrbo na domu, e-oskrbo ter storitve za ohranjanje in krepitev samostojnosti.
Več o pravicah in storitvah dolgotrajne oskrbe si lahko preberete na tej povezavi. Na voljo je tudi klicni center na številki 114, kjer lahko vsak delovni dan med 8. in 16. uro dobite preverjene in celovite informacije o dolgotrajni oskrbi.
Med najpogostejšimi izzivi, s katerimi se srečujejo družinski oskrbovalci, je tudi inkontinenca.
Ne glede na to, ali gre za uhajanje urina ali dvojno inkontinenco (uhajanje urina in blata), lahko ta pomembno vpliva na kakovost življenja uporabnika in njegovih bližnjih. Poleg same izbire ustreznega pripomočka je treba poskrbeti tudi za redno higieno, zaščito kože in čim večje udobje uporabnika.
Prav nega in skrb za kožo sta za oskrbovalce večji izziv, kot so pričakovali. Zaradi dolgotrajne izpostavljenosti trenju in dražečim snovem v izločkih se poveča tveganje za nastanek inkontinenčnega dermatitisa (IAD), ene najpogostejših težav oseb z inkontinenco.
Pri dolgotrajni oskrbi pogosto velja, da največjo razliko naredijo majhni vsakodnevni koraki.
Strokovnjaki zato za nego kože oseb z inkontinenco priporočajo preprost pristop v treh korakih:
Pomembno je, da izberete pripomoček za inkontinenco s hitro vpojnostjo, ki površino, kjer se vpojno jedro stika s kožo, ohranja suho in je izdelan iz zračnih materialov. Pomembno je, da pripomoček omogoča zračenje kože in tako podpira njeno naravno ravnovesje.
Ob menjavi pripomočka za inkontinenco je pomembno nežno in temeljito očistiti kožo. Pri tem je priporočljivo uporabljati izdelke, namenjene za občutljivo kožo, ki čistijo brez nepotrebnega draženja. Najpriročnejši so izdelki za čiščenje kože, ki jih ni treba izpirati z vodo.
Z leti postaja koža tanjša in občutljivejša. Redna uporaba negovalnih izdelkov, kot so vlažilne kreme in losjoni, pomaga ohranjati njeno prožnost in zmanjšuje izsušenost.
Na predelih, ki so pogosto izpostavljeni vlagi, pa posebna mazila ustvarijo dodatno zaščito med kožo in dražečimi dejavniki ter pomagajo zmanjšati možnost poškodb kože.
Ta pristop temelji na sistemu treh korakov za preprečevanje inkontinenčnega dermatitisa, ki ga uporabljajo tudi številni strokovnjaki v zdravstveni in socialni oskrbi.
Kateri izdelek za čiščenje in nego kože izbrati? Vprašajte digitalnega pomočnika.
Če niste prepričani, kateri izdelek izbrati, vam je lahko v pomoč brezplačno orodje danskega podjetja ABENA, ki na podlagi odgovorov na nekaj preprostih vprašanj o negi pripravi izbor izdelkov za čiščenje in nego kože. Preizkusite ga lahko na tej povezavi.
Pogost razlog za nelagodje, iztekanje ali draženje kože ni nujno stopnja inkontinence, ampak uporaba neustreznega pripomočka, lahko tudi njegova neustrezna namestitev.
Pri izbiri je treba upoštevati:
Ker je izdelkov za inkontinenco veliko, je odločitev pogosto zahtevna. O izbiri se lahko pogovorite z osebnim zdravnikom, ki lahko glede na stopnjo inkontinence predpiše pripomočke za inkontinenco tudi z naročilnico za medicinske pripomočke, ali s farmacevtom v lekarni. Na voljo pa je tudi brezplačno orodje, ki na podlagi vaših odgovorov pripravi nabor pripomočkov.
Skrb za bližnjega doma je lahko ena najlepših oblik medsebojne podpore. Hkrati pa je to odgovornost, ki prinaša številne nove naloge, znanja in odločitve.
Zato največ štejejo preverjene informacije, strokovni nasveti in pripomočki, ki olajšajo vsakdan.
Ko je nega v domačem okolju dobro organizirana, koža ustrezno zaščitena in pomoč na dosegu roke, ostane več časa za tisto, kar je zares pomembno: za pogovor, bližino in občutek varnosti.
Naročnik oglasne vsebine je ABENA-HELPI

title: Convictions linked to corrupt detective quashed
content:
Convictions linked to corrupt detective quashed
- Published
Two men convicted of stealing mailbags on the evidence of a corrupt police officer have had their convictions quashed, 50 years after they were found guilty.
Christopher Poulter, then 21, and Kevin Biggs, then 18, were convicted in 1976 of taking 13 mailbags from a railway wagon at Clapham goods yard in south London.
British Transport Police (BTP) officer Det Sgt Derek Ridgewell was one of three officers who said they saw the pair take the bags and drive off.
The Court of Appeal allowed their appeals on Tuesday. Biggs died in 2004.
'Disgrace'
The Criminal Cases Review Commission (CCRC) referred the case earlier this year after new evidence emerged about Ridgewell, who was jailed for seven years in 1980 for stealing goods worth more than £1m.
The CCRC said he had framed young black men for crimes he had committed himself.
At their trial at Inner London Crown Court, the pair said they had spent the whole evening in a pub in Tooting before officers approached and arrested them. Poulter was jailed for a year and Biggs was sent to borstal.
Their case came to light through a BTP investigation tracing people convicted on Ridgewell's evidence. They are the 14th and 15th people to have convictions overturned because of his misconduct.
A third man convicted alongside them, Stephen Simmons, had his conviction quashed in 2018.
Lord Justice Edis, sitting with Mr Justice Lavender and Mr Justice Linden, said the appeals should have been heard with Simmons's, but at the time it had not been possible to find Poulter or any of Biggs's relatives.
"The two appeals are allowed and the convictions quashed," he said.
Jenny Wiltshire, a solicitor who has represented many of Ridgewell's victims, said it was a "disgrace" that BTP had taken so long to find those affected.
"It is now half a century since these two men were found guilty of a crime they did not commit," she said.
"The British Transport Police knew for certain that the police officer whose evidence sent them to jail was corrupt just four years after they were convicted, and probably a lot earlier."
She said the force had failed to act at the time and had only recently begun to take the issue seriously.
"As a result of this inaction, Christopher Poulter has lived the majority of his life as a convicted criminal. Kevin Biggs died as one."
Ridgewell died in prison aged 37 in 1982.
BTP has been approached for comment.

title: Five young Dominicans complete 480-hour challenge to reclaim reading record
content:
Five young Dominicans complete 480-hour challenge to reclaim reading record
Santo Domingo.- Five young Dominicans completed 480 consecutive hours of reading aloud Sunday in an effort to reclaim the Guinness World Record for the longest reading marathon for the Dominican Republic.
Abril del Rosario, Ismael Durán, Maikol Arias, Mayury Vélez and Franchesca Minier reached the 480-hour mark at 6:00 p.m. after spending 20 days continuously participating in the challenge.
During the marathon, the group read 63 complete books while maintaining the activity around the clock.
Family, friends and supporters gathered to celebrate the participants as they completed the challenge, which aimed to promote reading and highlight the role of Dominican youth in education, culture and knowledge.
The initiative also seeks to bring the reading record back to the Dominican Republic, which organizers said previously held it about 15 years ago.
The participants will now submit evidence and documentation to Guinness World Records, which will determine whether the challenge met all requirements for official recognition.

title: Award-winning country singer takes music, dreams to northern First Nations
content:
Miles Morrisseau
ICT
Desiree Dorian grew up in the rural Manitoba town of Dauphin, renowned as the Ukrainian capital of Canada. It is also home to the longest running country music festival in the country with artists like Luke Combs, Eric Church performing in the past and Jelly Roll and Cameron Whitcomb performing this past summer.
When Dorian, Opaskwayak Cree Nation, was young she would leave her house and walk out beyond the edge of town and take her place on the empty Countryfest stage and sing her songs to the fallow fields.
In 2014, she made it to the main stage of the festival sharing the stage with Grammy Award-winning artists, The Band Perry. She has travelled all over Turtle Island, across the ocean and released eight studio albums.
In 2025, her release “Remember Her Name” was nominated for five Manitoba Country Music Awards. She took home Album of the Year and Female Artist of The Year.
It is a story of dreams coming true and on Sept. 18, she shared her stories and songs with the junior high students at the Grand Rapids school at the final stop on her northern Manitoba tour.
Accompanied on guitar by the incredible Bram Avery, Dorian sang songs and told stories that reflected the reality of Indigenous life and the power of Indigenous dreams.
The tour made stops on First Nations and Indigenous communities across northern Manitoba with stops at Pine Creek First Nations, Chemawawin Cree Nation and Sapoteweyak Cree Nation before ending up in Grand Rapids where the students from Misipawistik Cree Nation attend school. Dorian reached a youthful audience that was connecting with the truth of music.
“I’m working primarily in the Americana roots country genre and I know that’s not super popular amongst young people now, they want to hear hip-hop and stuff like that,” Dorian told ICT on steps of the school gymnasium shortly after her performance . “I authentically and genuinely tell my story that is written throughout my songs and that seems to be resonating with them so that’s been really cool.”
The tour was funded by the Manitoba Arts Network through the Indigenous Voices program bringing Indigenous artists into First Nation schools.
“It’s so important to me as a First Nations woman who grew up in a rural area to do my part to bring music to the schools,” Dorian said. “I had a little girl give me a note the other day in Chemawawin Cree Nation and she told me that I was the first concert that she’d ever seen, you know…you have no idea as an artist what kind of impact you’re making on a young person.”
She continues to make a living at her dream job without giving up her day job, she is also a lawyer. Dorian is continuing to ride the wave of her success while giving back to the community.
“We had a heck of a year we went to the Reeperbahn Festival (Germany) and we were invited back to a music conference in Paris, France the following month and I’ve been as far South as New Orleans and I’ve been all across Canada,” Dorian says. “I was a kid that came from not a whole lot and didn’t get to travel growing up, didn’t get to see anywhere really beyond the perimeter of my small town and so the fact that music has taken me halfway around the world is…I still pinch myself, it’s almost unbelievable.”
Dorian recently covered a song by Metis songwriter Gloria Desjaralais.
“In the course of getting permission to record that song she talked to me about how First Nations, Métis, Indigenous artists weren’t allowed to play the ‘A clubs’ in Winnipeg,” Dorian said. “They were relegated to the Main Street clubs and then if you were a woman on top of that you were even less welcome in those spaces.”
Things have changed in the 30 years that Dorian has been in the music business.
“There were no funding opportunities. There wasn’t as much education or awareness around the real history of what happened to Indigenous people in Canada really until the last 15 years or so,” Dorian says. “There’s been a lot more support for you know including Indigenous artists in all spaces right across right across the country I would say.”
As the teachers hurry their students back to class, a handful of kids linger near the stage offering Dorian appreciation for her music and perhaps some dreams of their own.

title: Weniger Kirchenaustritte in Kärnten
content:
Auch wenn sich die Religionslandschaft in den letzten Jahrzehnten stark verändert hat, bekennt sich mit knapp 56 Prozent immer noch mehr als die Hälfte der Kärntnerinnen und Kärntner zur Katholischen Kirche. Und die Zahl jener, die der Kirche den Rücken kehren, ist weiter gesunken.
Weniger Kirchenaustritte in Kärnten
Die Katholische Kirche Österreich hat am Mittwoch ihre Bilanz für das vergangene Jahr veröffentlicht. Neben dem Rechnungsabschluss stehen dabei auch immer die Kirchenaustritte im Fokus. Diese sind, wie schon in den Jahren davor, neuerlich zurückgegangen. Österreichweit und auch in Kärnten.
Sedlmaier: Menschen suchen Halt
Im vergangenen Jahr gab es 3.881 Kirchenaustritte, das ist ein Minus von 15 Prozent gegenüber 2024. Österreichweit liegt der Rückgang bei sechs Prozent. Gleichzeitig sind auch mehr Menschen wieder- oder neu in die Katholische Kirche eingetreten, nämlich 495. Im Jahr 2024 waren es 440. Seit einem Jahr ist das auch online möglich. „Ich bin geradezu glücklich darüber, dass sich diese Zahlen so positiv entwickelt haben und das ist für mich ein klares Zeichen dafür, dass Glaube und Kirche für das Leben unserer Menschen im Land eine große Bedeutung hat“, so Generalvikar Johann Sedlmaier.
Eine Rolle dürften hier wohl auch die aktuellen Krisen und Kriege spielen. „Menschen suchen natürlich in unsicheren Zeiten Halt und Ankerpunkte, wo sie sich orientieren können. Ich denke, die Kirche ist so ein Kraftort“, so Sedlmaier.
Plus im Rechnungsabschluss
Der Rückgang bei den Austritten wirkt sich auch auf die Finanzen der Kirche aus. Drei Viertel der Einnahmen stammen aus dem Kirchenbeitrag. Und so weist der Rechnungsabschluss für 2025 Jahr ein leichtes Plus aus. Angesichts steigender Kosten muss aber weiter gespart werden, unter anderem auch bei den Mitarbeitern. „In Summe versuchen wir einen Mitarbeiterstand auch zukünftig so zu entwickeln, dass wir nicht jede Position nachbesetzen und dass wir auf Basis einer hohen Flexibilität unserer Kolleginnen und Kollegen auch intern umschichten und die ein oder andere Position natürlich dann auch von außen dazukommt“, so der Direktor der Finanzkammer Gerhard Salzer.
Derzeit hat die Katholische Kirche Kärnten 722 Mitarbeiter, darunter 197 aktive Priester, die von etwa 40 Priestern, die bereits in Pension sind, unterstützt werden.

title: Soldiers rescue six kidnapped victims in Kaduna, Katsina
content:
Troops of the Joint Task Force North-West, Operation Fansan Yamma, have rescued six kidnapped victims during separate operations in Kaduna and Katsina states.
The victims were rescued on Thursday, September 17, 2026, following intelligence-led operations in Igabi Local Government Area of Kaduna State and the Dandume-Damari axis of Katsina State.
The Media Information Officer of the JTF North-West, Lt. Col. Aliyu Danja, disclosed this in a statement issued on Friday.
Danja said troops of Sector 1, acting on intelligence about a kidnapping incident in Igabi, made contact with terrorists moving some abducted victims.
He said the terrorists fled after sighting the troops, abandoning the victims.
According to him, the rescued victims were identified as Enock Hussaini, Abba Dauda and Kalif Haruna, who were abducted from Gidan Gulbi village on September 11.
“The victims were subsequently debriefed and reunited with their families, while troops continued to dominate the general area,” he said.
In Katsina, Danja said troops of Sector 2 responded to a distress call concerning the abduction of civilians along the Dandume-Damari axis.
He said the troops swiftly mobilised to the area and engaged the terrorists with “overwhelming firepower,” forcing them to flee into the surrounding bushes and abandon their victims.
The three rescued victims were identified as Abubakar Abdulkadir, 25; Mansir Idris, 26; and Abubakar Aliyu, 21.
The troops also recovered a black Golf vehicle belonging to the victims, while the rescued persons were later escorted and released to continue their journey.
Danja said the latest operations underscored the continued efforts of Operation Fansan Yamma to protect civilians, disrupt terrorist activities and deny criminals freedom of action across the Joint Operations Area.
He urged members of the public to remain vigilant and promptly report suspicious activities to the nearest security agency.

title: Dahra : Le ministre de la Formation professionnelle et technique assure la formation de 200 jeunes aux techniques de secourisme de protection et d’alerte
content:
Dahra : Le ministre de la Formation professionnelle et technique assure la formation de 200 jeunes aux techniques de secourisme de protection et d’alerte
À Dahra, le ministre de la Formation professionnelle et technique, Idrissa Samb, a permis à 200 jeunes issus de diverses catégories socioprofessionnelles d’être formés aux techniques d’alerte de protection et de secourisme.
Pendant quatre jours les bénéficiaires ont appris à alerter les sapeurs-pompiers en cas d’accident en donnant son numéro de téléphone, son nom si nécessaire, la nature et le nombre de victimes.
Ensuite, les jeunes ont été formés sur la prise en charge d’une victime inconsciente qui doit être toujours mise en position latérale de sécurité en basculant la tête vers l’arrière, selon le formateur le sergent-chef de la brigade des sapeurs-pompiers de Dahra, Kéba Ndour.
Les bénéficiaires ont été aussi formés sur la prise en charge d’une victime qui étouffe. Selon le sergent-chef Ndour, il y a deux types d’étouffements : partiel et obstruction totale. Si la victime s’étouffe, on doit lui administrer cinq claques sur le dos pour désobstruer le corps étranger ou la compression abdominale avant de la mettre au repos".
Enfin, les jeunes ont pu identifier les deux types d’hémorragies : interne qui est médicale et externe où ils ont appris comment arrêter le sang.
Globalement satisfaits, les jeunes formés ont remercié le ministre Idrissa Samb qui leur a donné l’occasion d’assimiler les techniques de secourisme de protection et d’alerte surtout dans cette partie du pays où les accidents sont fréquents.

title: Yango Fellowship brings together tech talent from six African countries to build locally rooted solutions
content:
Audio By Carbonatix
Yango Group has concluded the Pan-African Yango Fellowship 2026 programme with a two-day Graduation programme and Pitch Day in Abidjan, bringing together 24 Fellows from six African countries to present the tech projects they developed over the course of the programme.
The cohort included fellows from Côte d’Ivoire, Ghana, Zambia, Senegal, Ethiopia and Mozambique, selected from more than 600 applicants. Over the 12-week programme, fellows worked in six mixed-country teams, moving from problem framing and research through solution design, business modelling, prototyping and final pitching. The resulting projects span cashless payments for informal transport, digital financial identity for informal merchants, medicine supply visibility for community health workers, cross-border job matching, smart waste collection and recycling, and low-cost water-quality testing for rural communities.
The closing programme in Abidjan combined project development with exposure to technology and business leaders. Fellows joined a session on AI for impact with Celina Lee, co-founder of Zindi, took part in hands-on public speaking and pitch coaching, and met Yango Group leaders from several African markets to discuss career growth, entrepreneurship and building technology businesses in different local contexts.
At the final Pitch Day, fellows presented six team projects and selected individual projects to a jury of technology, investment and industry experts. The event concluded with an awards ceremony, with a total prize fund of USD12,000 recognising the strongest team and individual projects.
Africoded took the top group prize of USD 4,500 for its AI-assisted platform connecting African job seekers with cross-border employment, remote work and career-development opportunities across the continent. Harambee placed second, receiving USD 2,500 for a smart waste collection and recycling platform connecting households, waste collectors and recyclers, while Bloom took third place and USD 1,500 for its African Transit Payment Revolution, a cashless fare-collection system designed for informal public transport across East and West Africa.
In the individual category, Fredrick Mwepu of Zambia won the USD 1,500 Best Individual Project award for RoboCore Zambia, a locally developed robotics platform designed to make practical STEM education more accessible and affordable. Ghana’s Meshack Kwame Nartey received the USD 1,000 runner-up prize for Shuttle Smart Ghana, an app that tracks university shuttles and gives students real-time information on their arrival. Oulimata Rose Dia received the USD 1,000 Best Technical/AI Contribution award for Smart Bin Collection, a solar-powered system that monitors bin fill levels in real time and uses 2G connectivity to support more efficient waste collection.
"600 applications for 24 places doesn't tell you Africa lacks talent, it tells you how much talent is waiting for structured access to mentorship and opportunity. Africa has no shortage of brilliant young people. What's harder to find is a mentor, a network, and the opportunity to test an idea against a real problem. That's the specific gap this Fellowship exists to close" said Shashi Singh, Director of Operations, Yango Ride MEA & Asia.
"Growing up, hands-on STEM tools were something I only saw in videos — RoboCore Zambia exists to close that gap, so the next student who wants to build something doesn't have to wait for the chance I almost didn't get, I am excited that my project got to see the light of day and it was a wonderful experience to travel, meet other fellows from all other countries and learn directly from experts and leaders in Tech and AI. This is an experience I will never forget" said Fredrick Mwepu, Zambian STEM student and winner of the Best Individual Project award for RoboCore Zambia, his locally developed robotics platform designed to make practical STEM education more accessible and affordable.
The programme responds to a wider reality across the continent: digital growth depends on people, not only infrastructure. Building and scaling technology locally requires engineers, entrepreneurs and technology professionals with practical experience — and people who understand the realities of their own markets. For Yango Group, investing in that talent is closely linked to how the company builds across Africa: different markets have different infrastructure, behaviours and needs, so strong local businesses require strong local expertise. The Fellowship is one way Yango helps strengthen that talent pipeline while building connections across Africa’s wider technology ecosystem.

title: V Veliki Britaniji pacientkam z rakom brez razloga odstranili dojke
content:
V bolnišnicah na severovzhodu Anglije so med zdravljenjem raka prsi 20 bolnicam odstranili dojke. Incident je potrdilo vodstvo bolnišnic County Durham and Darlington (CDDFT), ki delujejo v okviru britanskega javnega zdravstvenega sistema NHS, poroča Guardian.
Steve Russell, direktor CDDFT, se je v imenu organizacije družinam opravičil za nastalo škodo in povedal, da se zaveda, kakšen vpliv ima to na pacientke. Po njegovih besedah so od takrat uvedli spremembe, zaradi katerih naj bi se oskrba izboljšala.
Še naprej preiskujejo, kaj se je v resnici zgodilo, in poskušajo pacientkam nuditi informacije in podporo. Odbor se bo sestal 24. septembra, do tedaj ne bodo sprejeli nobene končne odločitve.
Pregledali so 514 primerov, od tega je bilo prizadetih 315 pacientk, 77 jih je utrpelo hujše posledice, ena je celo umrla. Russell je povedal, da nekaterih rakov niso odkrili pravočasno, zato so se razširili.
Pacientka je za Guardian povedala, da niso opravili dovolj pregledov in biopsij, ki bi pokazali, da so druga območja benigna in da gre dejansko za raka v dojki.
Še eni pacientki so leta 2023 odkrili raka dojke v prvem stadiju, opravili so lumpektomijo in odstranili bezgavke, vendar so ji na ponovnem pregledu še vedno zatrdili, da potrebuje mastektomijo.
Mastektomija je kirurška odstranitev ene ali obeh dojk.
Pri lumpektomiji kirurg odstrani rakave celice z majhno količino nekaj okoliškega tkiva, hkrati pa ohrani čim večji del dojke.
Z oddajo e-poštnega naslova se prijavim na uredniške e-novice družbe Delo mediji d. o. o. Odjava je možna kadar koli prek povezave »Odjava« v vsakem sporočilu. Več v Politiki zasebnosti.

title: MST celebrou diversidade artística LGBTQIAPN+ no Festival da Diversidade em Caruaru (PE)
content:
No último sábado (18), o Movimento dos Trabalhadores Rurais Sem Terra (MST), por meio de seu coletivo LGBTQIAPN+, realizou seu primeiro Festival da Diversidade, em Caruaru. Organizado no centro da cidade, o evento contou com um palco montado no principal ponto da vida noturna, no entorno do Pátio de Eventos, que recebeu shows, performances e discotecagem, celebrando a pluralidade da cena artística LGBTQIAPN+ caruaruense.
A noite contou com 14 atrações, englobando manifestações culturais que passaram por performances drag queen, intervenções, hip-hop e discotecagem. A programação foi apresentada pela artista drag Rubbie e ainda contou com intervenções de Stella Diamonds e Benedita Araújo, performances de Rubbie, Dionísio, Yannara e Aurora, além da discotecagem de Kylipe, Gabiiip, Yohanna, Victor Preto, Chanel do Agreste, Xunior e Indecisões.
“Convidamos artistas que vivenciam e ocupam cada vez mais essa cidade, mas que ainda são invisibilizados por muitas vezes. O festival funciona como um motor de estímulo à cultura de nossa cidade, com os mais diversos vieses artísticos que temos na nossa população LGBTQIAPN+. Fizemos também um evento de viés político e saímos extremamente felizes, com as forças renovadas para enfrentar o conservadorismo e a política de morte e invisibilidade que tentam impor diariamente à população LGBTQIAPN+”, declara Rafaela Barcelo, coordenadora e articuladora cultural do MST-PE e responsável pela programação do evento.
A organização também encarou a realização do evento como uma disputa simbólica pela ocupação da cidade pela população LGBTQIAPN+, montando a estrutura em um espaço já ocupado pela comunidade, mas que ainda também possui a presença de um público conservador. “Ocupamos esse lugar com muito leque, alegria e música. O corpo LGBTQIAPN+ é um corpo político, então foi importante estarmos fazendo essa festa na principal rua da cidade”, afirma Gabriella Ambrósio, coordenadora de comunicação da secretaria estadual do MST e uma das organizadoras do festival.
O evento também foi um resgate da história e tradição de Caruaru em eventos voltados para a comunidade. Gabriella relembra, por exemplo, da notória vida noturna na Rua Silvino Macedo, que passou a ser mais conhecida como Rua da Má Fama justamente por ser ocupada por corpos dissidentes. “Essa rua não existe mais, o conservadorismo venceu, mas não vai nos calar. Nesse evento, revivemos a Rua da Má Fama de uma forma livre, gratuita e bonita. É como sempre dizemos, o patriarcado destrói, o capitalismo faz a guerra, mas o sangue LGBT também é sangue sem terra”, conclui Ambrósio.

title: My friendships with people in their 50s, 60s, 70s, and 80s got me through my divorce at 27
content:
Last year, at 27, I went through a divorce. The experience came with a lot of conflicting emotions and logistical issues to sort through — not to mention the additional task of getting reacquainted with myself after years in an unhappy relationship.
All this was happening while I was living hundreds of miles away from my family, who had always been my support system. So I turned to my local community, including friends in their 50s, 60s, 70s, and 80s.
I'd started forming these friendships before my divorce. While I was married, I joined a local Italian Club, where I'd exercise my fluency in the language alongside Italians, Italian-Americans, Italianophiles, and Italian-language learners, most of whom were in their 50s and beyond.
I also attended a weekly Zumba class, where many of the dancers were decades older than me.
Creating this community on my own when I was married was part of what helped me feel ready to take the leap into divorce — and, in the wake of my breakup, these friends helped me more than I could have ever imagined.
Some of my older friends had been through divorces of their own
I didn't tell everyone that I was going through a divorce, but I confided in a few people who stepped up to support me.
One of my 50-something Italian Club friends invited me out for drinks to share her experience going through a divorce years earlier. Another friend of mine in her 60s told me that her divorce had been one of the best things to happen to her.
An Italian friend in her 80s gave me a warm hug each week and asked how I was doing, giving me a chance to talk about my feelings in Italian and providing reassurance.
Of course, I also sought support from friends my own age. But many of them were going through breakups at the same time, or struggling with long-term partnerships, careers, and other big life questions.
I leaned on them, too, but found that the encouragement I got from much older friends who were well-established in their lives was just as essential to my healing. Italian Club and Zumba class became cornerstones of my life, and knowing I had these activities on my schedule kept me going throughout the week.
Even just interacting with this network of older people helped me remember that my grief and fear were temporary. I watched in Zumba class as the people around me, many of whom were 20 or 30 years my seniors, danced with utter abandon.
They must have lived through so many difficult times, breakups, and life transitions, I reminded myself, and look at them now.
Thanks to my community, I got through my divorce feeling loved
Sooner than expected, my sadness gave way to a kind of joy and freedom I hadn't felt in years. I rebuilt my identity not as a woman who was alone, but as a woman surrounded by people who cared for her.
What I wanted my life to look like in the future still felt murky and uncertain, but when I was speaking Italian or shaking my hips to upbeat Zumba songs, I knew exactly who I was.
Plus, opening up about something difficult in my life brought me closer to many of my friends, some of whom I've since supported through their own difficult times.
These friendships with people decades older than me helped me reframe my divorce as just a splotch on the hopefully much longer timeline of my life. Without them, I'm not sure I would have come through this life transition as healthy, happy, and surrounded by love.
I will always be grateful, and I hope I get the chance to pay their kindness forward someday.

title: Rescatistas devolvieron a su dueña dinero hallado entre los escombros de Residencias Caribe, en La Guaira
content:
Entre los restos de las Residencias Caribe, en La Guaira, voluntarios encontraron dinero mientras avanzaban en labores de búsqueda y recuperación de pertenencias. En lugar de incorporarlo entre los objetos recuperados, decidieron localizar a su dueña y devolvérselo.
El hallazgo fue protagonizado por integrantes del equipo de rescate Máquina de Hierro, quienes contactaron a una mujer que permanecía en el lugar en busca de su esposo. El momento de la entrega quedó registrado en un video publicado por la periodista Maryorin Méndez, que compartió el diálogo entre los rescatistas y la afectada.
"Nosotros acabamos de encontrarte un dinero aquí abajo, mi vida. Queremos hacerte la entrega de este dinero", le dice uno de los voluntarios mientras le muestra los billetes recuperados entre los restos de la estructura.
Los rescatistas también habían encontrado documentos, prendas y otros objetos personales. Durante la conversación explicaron que fueron separando las pertenencias que aparecían durante la remoción para entregarlas a sus propietarios o familiares.
La mujer rompió en llanto al recibir el dinero y explicó que no se trataba de una suma cualquiera. Había pasado un año reuniendo esos ahorros con la intención de iniciar un negocio.
“Nosotros íbamos a empezar esa misma semana del 24, estuve parada un año guardando, guardando, guardando, para salir adelante y tener mi propio negocio”, contó.
Los voluntarios insistieron en que querían devolverle todo lo que pudiera recuperarse.
“Todo lo que salga de aquí está en ellos” le explicaron, mientras continuaban revisando los restos en busca de documentos y objetos que pudieran pertenecer a las familias afectadas.
Labores de rescate continúan tres meses después de los terremotos
El episodio ocurrió casi tres meses después de los terremotos del 24 de junio que devastaron zonas de La Guaira y dejaron miles de víctimas y cientos de estructuras colapsadas. El paso del tiempo no ha significado el cierre de las labores en todos los puntos afectados: en Caribe todavía permanecen equipos dedicados a la remoción y búsqueda de víctimas y pertenencias.
Este lunes, por ejemplo, voluntarios del Campamento Madrid reportaron que mantienen las labores de rescate y remoción de escombros en la zona. El grupo reúne a 29 rescatistas procedentes de otros lugares del país.
La búsqueda no se limita a los restos humanos. A medida que se remueve el material de las edificaciones destruidas aparecen documentos, fotografías, ropa y otros objetos que alguna vez formaron parte de la vida cotidiana de quienes habitaban esos edificios. La magnitud de los escombros ha convertido su clasificación y retiro en uno de los grandes desafíos de la recuperación.

Επιχείρηση διάσωσης 34χρονου στον Όλυμπο - Μεταφέρθηκε με ασφάλεια και τον παρέλαβε το ΕΚΑΒ
Στην επιχείρηση συμμετείχαν 11 πυροσβέστες, με τρία πυροσβεστικά οχήματα, από τη 2η και την 8η ΕΜΑΚ
Αίσιο τέλος είχε η επιχείρηση της Πυροσβεστικής στον Όλυμπο για την παροχή βοήθειας σε έναν 34χρονο αλλοδαπό, ο οποίος τραυματίστηκε σε δύσβατο σημείο, πλησίον της θέσης «Σπηλιά Ιθακήσιου».

Το Κέντρο Επιχειρήσεων του Πυροσβεστικού Σώματος ενημερώθηκε για το περιστατικό περίπου στις 13:00, έπειτα από κλήση στο 112. Ακολούθησε άμεσος γεωεντοπισμός του άνδρα και κινητοποιήθηκαν συνολικά 11 πυροσβέστες, με τρία πυροσβεστικά οχήματα, από τη 2η και την 8η ΕΜΑΚ, καθώς και από την Πυροσβεστική Υπηρεσία Λιτοχώρου.

Οι πυροσβέστες εντόπισαν τον 34χρονο τραυματισμένο και προσέγγισαν το σημείο, χρησιμοποιώντας τον απαραίτητο ορειβατικό εξοπλισμό. Στη συνέχεια, τον μετέφεραν με ασφάλεια σε προσβάσιμο σημείο, όπου παρελήφθη από ασθενοφόρο του ΕΚΑΒ.

title: Landwirte aus OÖ als Spitzenwinzer
content:
Bis Ende des 17. Jahrhunderts hatte der Weinbau in Oberösterreich Tradition. Mit der sogenannten „Kleinen Eiszeit“ verschwand er jedoch weitgehend. Erst vor rund 30 Jahren begannen erste Betriebe wieder damit, Weingärten anzulegen. Heute wachsen Reben in allen vier Vierteln des Landes.
Die Dokumentation „Wein aus 4 Vierteln – Wenn aus oö. Landwirten Spitzenwinzer werden“ begleitet mehrere Weinbaubetriebe durch das Jahr. Gestaltet wurde der Film von Wolfgang Marecek und Markus Fischer für das ORF Landesstudio Oberösterreich.
Neue Chancen für Landwirtschaft
Viele Gemüse- und Ackerbaubetriebe sehen im Weinbau ein zusätzliches wirtschaftliches Standbein. Der Aufbau eines Weingartens gilt allerdings als arbeitsintensiv und risikoreich. Petra Schmuckenschlager aus Enns und ihr Ehemann Florian setzen bereits seit Jahren auf Weinbau. Auch ihre Kinder studieren inzwischen Weinbau und arbeiten im Betrieb mit.
Gezeigt werden außerdem zwei Jungwinzerpaare aus Wolfern (Bezirk Steyr-Land) und Niederneukirchen (Bezirk Linz-Land), die von erfahrenen Betrieben unterstützt werden. Die Dokumentation begleitet sie etwa beim Rebschnitt und bei Jungweinverkostungen.
PIWI-Reben als Versuch
Ein Schwerpunkt liegt auch auf sogenannten pilzwiderstandsfähigen Rebsorten. Wolfgang Költringer aus Weilbach (Bezirk Ried im Innkreis) testet in einem Versuchsweingarten unterschiedliche Weißwein- und Rotweinsorten. Ziel ist es laut Film, den Einsatz von Pflanzenschutzmitteln zu reduzieren.
Sommelière Dagmar Gross ordnet die Entwicklung des oberösterreichischen Weinbaus ein. Sie sieht bei den Betrieben viel Qualität und Engagement, erwartet langfristig aber auch ein klareres Profil der Region.
Auszeichnungen für junge Betriebe
Dass Weine aus Oberösterreich inzwischen auch überregional Aufmerksamkeit bekommen, zeigt laut Dokumentation unter anderem Lukas Schiefermair aus Kematen an der Krems (Bezirk Linz-Land). Der 31-Jährige wurde bereits mehrfach ausgezeichnet.
Auch Leonhard Gmeiner aus Perg zählt zu den Pionieren des modernen Weinbaus in Oberösterreich. Er berät heute als Präsident des Landesweinbauverbands regelmäßig neue Betriebe. Geschäftsführer Klaus Stummvoll verweist im Film darauf, dass Oberösterreich mit rund 100 Hektar Rebfläche österreichweit zwar klein sei, sich die Szene aber dynamisch entwickle.
Dieser Beitrag begleitet die Dokumentation „Wein aus 4 Vierteln – Wenn aus oö. Landwirten Spitzenwinzer werden“ (Gestaltung: Wolfgang Marecek und Markus Fischer). Diese ist am Sonntag um 18.25 Uhr in ORF 2 sowie im Stream auf ORF ON zu sehen.

title: Mar, Gisela, Darius y Pablo tienen entre 9 y 15 años y son los únicos españoles que disputan estos días las Olimpiadas de Tecnología
content: Sus proyectos ofrecen soluciones prácticas ante la contaminación marina, la ciberseguridad, el esfuerzo personal y el acoso escolar en las aulasEl móvil para la tercera edad nacido en Zaragoza que ya utilizan más de 5.000 personasLa tecnología recupera un campo de batalla de la Primera Guerra Mundial oculto bajo una urbanización Las Olimpiadas Internacionales de Tecnología de la Fundación NTT DATA han convocado a más de cinco mil participantes de nueve países, una gran cita internacional para la que únicamente cuatro estudiantes españoles han logrado clasificarse para disputar la final virtual. Gisela Pérez, Pablo Gil, Mar y Darius Atanasiu, con edades de entre nueve y quince años, representan la creatividad y el compromiso social del talento digital en España. Sus proyectos en la plataforma Scratch ofrecen soluciones prácticas ante problemas como la contaminación marina, la ciberseguridad, el esfuerzo personal y el acoso escolar en las aulas cotidianas. Con solo nueve años de edad, la barcelonesa Gisela Pérez es la participante más joven de la delegación española en la final internacional. Su aventura interactiva, titulada “Huella humana”, nació tras observar con tristeza la acumulación de plásticos y residuos durante sus excursiones familiares a las playas y bosques. El juego arranca en la orilla del mar ante un brick de leche flotando, preguntando al usuario qué haría al verlo tirado. Mediante retos de limpieza del entorno natural y decisiones responsables guiadas por un avatar propio, Gisela demuestra que los pequeños gestos diarios son esenciales para proteger la salud ecológica del planeta entero. Desde Vejer de la Frontera, en la provincia de Cádiz, el estudiante de once años Pablo Gil destaca en la competición gracias a su proyecto enfocado en la ciberseguridad infantil. Denominado “Internet seguro”, el juego fue creado tras descubrir su apasionada curiosidad por la informática durante el confinamiento. Preocupado por los riesgos digitales que afrontan sus compañeros al navegar solos por la red, Pablo diseñó retos prácticos para detectar mensajes fraudulentos, contraseñas débiles y trampas de desconocidos. La iniciativa promueve una lección clave: en este juego nadie gana ni pierde, pues todo el mundo aprende a proteger sus datos personales con responsabilidad. La barcelonesa Gisela Pérez es la participante más joven de la delegación española en la final internacional con una aventura interactiva titulada “Huella humana” En Salamanca, la joven Mar Miguel, de trece años, se situó entre las ganadoras nacionales tras competir con su videojuego interactivo “Patinando con Minion”. Desarrollado con el apoyo de mentores de la entidad organizadora, el proyecto transmite que aprender cualquier habilidad nueva exige paciencia, dedicación y superación constante ante los obstáculos. Mediante dinámicas de juego progresivas, la propuesta enseña que cometer errores forma parte natural de la educación y que lo fundamental es mantener el entusiasmo por intentarlo de nuevo. La aportación de Mar demuestra que la tecnología resulta idónea para cultivar la perseverancia y el pensamiento crítico juvenil. En la categoría de los participantes de mayor edad, Darius Atanasiu, un madrileño de quince años vecino de Pinto, presenta el videojuego “Máscara” contra el acoso escolar. Darius, alumno de cuarto de la ESO y programador autodidacta desde los once años, dedicó quince horas a estructurar una propuesta que empieza preguntando al jugador sobre su postura ética frente al acoso. A través de minijuegos sobre empatía e inclusión, la historia muestra cómo los estudiantes afectados ayudan al protagonista, dejando claro que no hay que callarse ante las injusticias. Su proyecto fomenta la solidaridad activa y el trabajo en equipo en los centros educativos. Dos minutos La propuesta de Darius resulta especialmente oportuna ante los datos actuales de acoso escolar en España, donde un 14% del alumnado sufre acoso o ciberbullying. El estudiante sostiene que un videojuego informal logra concienciar mejor a los jóvenes que las charlas tradicionales, al involucrarlos en una experiencia reflexiva activa. Para llegar a la final, Darius compaginó sus estudios ordinarios con diez exigentes módulos técnicos, apoyado por una familia que valora la disciplina y el trabajo autodidacta. Su esfuerzo demuestra el enorme potencial de la tecnología cuando se orienta hacia la convivencia pacífica y el bienestar emocional. Ante la inminente final virtual, los cuatro representantes españoles ultiman sus presentaciones de dos minutos en formato videollamada ante un jurado internacional. Gisela, Pablo, Mar y Darius han demostrado que la programación informática puede transformar retos cotidianos en valiosas herramientas de cambio social. Su logro posiciona a la educación pública y al talento joven de España en el mapa internacional de la innovación digital. Ganen o no en la cita decisiva, estos cuatro estudiantes han probado que la tecnología combinada con la empatía es el mejor camino para construir un futuro mucho más limpio, seguro, justo e inclusivo para toda la sociedad.

title: Acceptatie homoseksualiteit hard onderuit onder jongeren op middelbare school
content: Jongeren in Nederland zijn de afgelopen vier jaar negatiever gaan denken over homoseksualiteit. Dit concluderen het Trimbos-instituut en Universiteit Utrecht in het terugkerende HBSC-onderzoek. Daarin kijken onderzoekers naar het mentale welzijn van jongeren uit het laatste jaar van de basisschool en het voortgezet onderwijs.
